verses.geez: ወእሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ብሔር፡ እለ፡ ዓርጉ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወገብኡ፡ እምኀበ፡ ተፄወው፡ ወፈለሱ፡ እለ፡ አፍለሶሙ፡ ናቡከደነፆር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ባቢሎን፡ ውስተ፡ ባቢሎን፡ ወተመይጡ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: And these are the people of the land that went up, of the number of prisoners who were removed, whom Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon carried away to Babylon, and they returned to Juda and Jerusalem, every man to his city;

translations.ron: Iată fiii ţării, dintre robii strămutaţi din Iuda, pe care Nabucodonosor, regele Babilonului, i-a dus la Babilon, care s-au întors şi au venit la Ierusalim şi în Iuda, fiecare în oraşul său, cu Zorobabel,
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς χώρας οἱ ἀναβαίνοντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας τῆς ἀποικίας, ἧς ἀπῴκισε Ναβουχοδονόσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Βαβυλῶνα, καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ Ἰούδα ἀνὴρ εἰς πόλιν αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: ወሰብአ፡ ይሁዳኒ፡ አተዉ፡ ውስተ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ወፅኡ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘሩባቤል፡ ኢዮስስ፡ ወነሕምያ፡ ወሶራያ፡ ወሮሐልያ፡ ወመርዶክዮስ፡ ወበልሳን፡ ወመሴፋር፡ ወመጉይ፡ ወሬሁም፡ ወበዓና፡ ወኮነ፡ ኊልቆሙ፡ ለሰብአ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: who came with Zorobabel: Jesus, Neemias, Saraias, Reelias, Mardochæus, Balasan, Masphar, Baguai, Reum, Baana. The number of the people of Israel:

translations.ron: Iosua, Neemia, Seraia, Reelaia, Nahamani, Mardoheu, Bilşan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum şi Baana. Numărul oamenilor poporului israelit care s-au întors a fost acesta:
translations.grk: Οἳ ἦλθον μετὰ Ζοροβάβελ, Ἰησοῦς, Νεεμίας, Σαραΐας, Ῥεελίας, Μαρδοχαῖος, Βαλασὰν, Μασφὰρ, Βαγουαὶ, Ῥεοὺμ, Βαανά· ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς λαοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ፋሩአስ፡ ዕሥራ፡ ምእት፡ ወአሐዱ፡ ምእት፡ ወሰብዓ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Phares, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Fares: două mii o sută şaptezeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Φαρὲς, δισχίλιοι ἑκατὸν ἑβδομηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ሰፋትያ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወሰብዓ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Saphatia, three hundred and seventy-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şefatia: trei sute şaptezeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σαφατία, τριακόσιοι ἑβδομηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ኤራ፡ ሰብዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወሰብዓ፡ ወኃምስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Ares, seven hundred and seventy-five.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Arah: şapte sute şaptezeci şi cinci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἄρες, ἑπτακόσιοι ἑβδομηκονταπέντε.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ፈሐትሞአብ፡ እለ፡ እምትውልደ፡ ያሱኤ፡ ወዮአብ፡ ዕሥራ፡ ምእት፡ ወሰመንቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Phaath Moab, belonging to the sons of Jesue and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Pahat-Moab, din fiii lui Iosua şi Ioab: două mii opt sute doisprezece;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Φαὰθ Μωὰβ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰησουὲ Ἰωὰβ, δισχίλιοι ὀκτακόσιοι δεκαδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ኤላም፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ኃምሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Ælam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Elam: o mie două sute cincizeci şi patru;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Αἰλὰμ, χίλιοι διακόσιοι πεντηκοντατέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ዛቱዕ፡ ተስዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወአርባዓ፡ ወኃምስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Zatthua, nine hundred and forty-five.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Zatu: nouă sute patruzeci şi cinci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ζατθουὰ, ἐννακόσιοι τεσσαρακονταπέντε.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ዛኬ፡ ሰብዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወስሳ።
verses.translation: The children of Zacchu, seven hundred and sixty.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Zacai: şapte sute şaizeci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ζακχοὺ, ἑπτακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ባኑ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወአርባዓ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Banui, six hundred and forty-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Bani: şase sute patruzeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βανουὶ, ἑξακόσιοι τεσσαρακονταδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ባቤ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Babai, six hundred and twenty-three.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Bebai: şase sute douăzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βαβαῒ, ἑξακόσιοι εἰκοσιτρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ አዜጌድ፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Asgad, a thousand two hundred and twenty-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Azgad: o mie două sute douăzeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀσγὰδ, χίλιοι διακόσιοι εἰκοσιδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አዶኒቃም፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ስሳ፡ ወስድስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Adonicam, six hundred and sixty-six.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Adonicam: şase sute şaizeci şi şase;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀδωνικὰμ, ἑξακόσιοι ἑξηκονταέξ.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ቤጋዊ፡ ዕሥራ፡ ምእት፡ ወኃምሳ፡ ወስድስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Bague, two thousand and fifty-six.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Bigvai: două mii cincizeci şi şase;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βαγουὲ, δισχίλιοι πεντηκονταέξ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አዴን፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወኃምሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Addin, four hundred and fifty-four.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Adin: patru sute cincizeci şi patru;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀδδὶν, τετρακόσιοι πεντηκοντατέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አጤር፡ ዘሕዝቅያ፡ ተስዓ፡ ወሰመንቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Ater the son of Ezekias, ninety-eight.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ater, din casa lui Iezechia: nouăzeci şi opt;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀτὴρ τῷ Ἐζεκίᾳ, ἐννενηκονταοκτώ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ቤሳይ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Bassu, three hundred and twenty-three.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Beţai: trei sute douăzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βασσοῦ, τριακόσιοι εἰκοσιτρεῖς.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ኡራ፡ ምእት፡ ወዓሠርቱ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Jora, a hundred and twelve.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iora: o sută doisprezece;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἰωρὰ, ἑκατὸν δεκαδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ሐሱም፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Asum, two hundred and twenty-three.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Haşum: două sute douăzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀσοὺμ, διακόσιοι εἰκοσιτρεῖς.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ጋቤር፡ ተስዓ፡ ወኃምስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Gaber, ninety-five.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ghibar: nouăzeci şi cinci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Γαβὲρ, ἐννενηκονταπέντε.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ቤተ፡ ልሔም፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Bethlaem, a hundred and twenty-three.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Betleem: o sută douăzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βεθλαὲμ, ἑκατὸν εἰκοσιτρεῖς.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ናጡፋ፡ ኃምሳ፡ ወስድስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Netopha, fifty-six.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Netofa: cincizeci şi şase;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Νετωφὰ, πεντηκονταέξ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አናቶት፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ወሰመንቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Anatot: o sută douăzeci şi opt;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀναθὼθ, ἑκατὸν εἰκοσιοκτώ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አስሙት፡ አርባዓ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Azmoth, forty-three.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Betazmavet: patruzeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀζμὼθ, τεσσαρακοντατρεῖς.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ቀርያታርም፡ ቃፌር፡ ወቢሮት፡ ሰብዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወአርባዓ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Cariathiarim, Chaphira, and Beroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

translations.ron: Din Chiriat-Iearim, Chefira şi Beerot: şapte sute patruzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Καριαθιαρὶμ, Χαφιρὰ, καὶ Βηρὼθ, ἑπτακόσιοι τεσσαρακοντατρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ሐርማ፡ ወጋባእ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወአሐዱ።
verses.translation: The children of Rama and Gabaa, six hundred and twenty-one.

translations.ron: Din Rama şi Gheba: şase sute douăzeci şi unu;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ τῆς Ῥαμὰ καὶ Γαβαὰ, ἑξακόσιοι εἰκοσιεῖς.

verses.geez: ወሰብአ፡ መኪማስ፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The men of Machmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Micmas: o sută douăzeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Ἄνδρες Μαχμὰς, ἑκατὸν εἰκοσιδύο.

verses.geez: ሰብአ፡ ቤቴል፡ ወኤአ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: The men of Bæthel and Aia, four hundred and twenty-three.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Betel şi din Ai: două sute douăzeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Ἄνδρες Βαιθὴλ καὶ Ἀϊὰ, τετρακόσιοι εἰκοσιτρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ናቡ፡ ሐምሳ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Nabu, fifty-two.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Nebo: cincizeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ναβοῦ, πεντηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ መጌባስ፡ ምእት፡ ወሐምሳ፡ ወስድስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Magebis, a hundred and fifty-six.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Magbiş: o sută cincizeci şi şase;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Μαγεβὶς, ἑκατὸν πεντηκονταέξ.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ኤሪም፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሐምሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Elamar, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

translations.ron: Fiii celuilalt Elam: o mie două sute cincizeci şi patru;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἠλαμὰρ, χίλιοι διακόσιοι πεντηκοντατέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አላም፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ።
verses.translation: The children of Elam, three hundred and twenty.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Harim: trei sute douăzeci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἠλὰμ, τριακόσιοι εἴκοσι.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ሎጥ፡ ኀዲድ፡ ወሐኖን፡ ወደቂቀ፡ ሐዲድ፡ ወሐኖን፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወሐምስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Lodadi and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-five.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Lod, Hadid şi Ono: şapte sute douăzeci şi cinci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Λοδαδὶ καὶ Ὠνὼ, ἑπτακόσιοι εἰκοσιπέντε.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ኢያሪኮ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ አርባዓ፡ ወሐምስቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

translations.ron: Oamenii din Ierihon: trei sute patruzeci şi cinci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἱεριχὼ, τριακόσιοι τεσσαρακονταπέντε.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ሲአናህ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ምእት፡ ወስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወሠላሳ።
verses.translation: The children of Senaa, three thousand six hundred and thirty.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Senaa: trei mii şase sute treizeci;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σεναὰ, τρισχίλιοι ἑξακόσιοι τριάκοντα.

verses.geez: ወካህናትኒ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኢየሐዶ፡ እለ፡ እምቤተ፡ ኢዮስስ፡ ተስዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሰብዓ፡ ወሠለስቱ።
verses.translation: And the priests, the sons of Jedua, belonging to the house of Jesus, were nine hundred and seventy-three.

translations.ron: Preoţi: fiii lui Iedaia, din casa lui Iosua: nouă sute şaptezeci şi trei;
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς υἱοὶ Ἰεδουὰ τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰησοῖ, ἐννακόσιοι ἑβδομηκοντατρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ኤሜር፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሐምሳ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Emmer, a thousand and fifty-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Imer: o mie cincizeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἐμμὴρ, χίλιοι πεντηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ፋሲሆር፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ አርባዓ፡ ወሰብዓቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Phassur, a thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Paşhur: o mie două sute patruzeci şi şapte;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Φασσοὺρ, χίλιοι διακόσιοι τεσσαρακονταεπτά.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ኤረም፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዓሠርቱ፡ ወሰብዓቱ።
verses.translation: The children of Erem, a thousand and seven.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Harim: o mie şaptesprezece;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἠρὲμ, χίλιοι ἑπτά.

verses.geez: ወሌዋውያንሰ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኢዮስስ፡ ወቀዳምሄል፡ እምደቂቀ፡ ሁድያ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ወአርባዕቱ።
verses.translation: And the Levites, the sons of Jesus and Cadmiel, belonging to the sons of Oduia, seventy-four.

translations.ron: Leviţi: fiii lui Iosua şi Cadmiel, din fiii lui Hodavia: şaptezeci şi patru;
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ Λευῖται υἱοὶ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Καδμιὴλ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ὠδουΐα, ἑβδομηκοντατέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ወእለ፡ ይዜምሩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አሳፍ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ወሰመንቱ።
verses.translation: The sons of Asaph, singers, a hundred and twenty-eight.

translations.ron: Cântăreţi: fiii lui Asaf: o sută douăzeci şi opt;
translations.grk: Οἱ ᾄδοντες υἱοὶ Ἀσὰφ, ἑκατὸν εἰκοσιοκτώ.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ፡ ሱዓሪም፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሱላም፡ ደቂቀ፡ አጤር፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጤልሞን፡ ደቂቀ፡ ዓቁብ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አጤጣ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰበዊይ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ምእት፡ ወሠላሳ፡ ወተስዓቱ።
verses.translation: The children of the porters, the children of Sellum, the children of Ater, the children of Telmon, the children of Acub, the children of Atita, the children of Sobai, in all a hundred and thirty-nine.

translations.ron: Fiii portarilor: fiii lui Şalum, fiii lui Ater, fiii lui Talmon, fiii lui Acuv, fiii lui Hatita, fiii lui Şobai, cu toţii la un loc: o sută treizeci şi nouă;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ τῶν πυλωρῶν, υἱοὶ Σελλοὺμ, υἱοὶ Ἀτὴρ, υἱοὶ Τελμὼν, υἱοὶ Ἀκοὺβ, υἱοὶ Ἀτιτὰ, υἱοὶ Σωβαῒ, οἱ πάντες ἑκατὸν τριακονταεννέα.

verses.geez: ሰብአ፡ ናታኒም፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሲካ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አሱፌ፡ ወደቂቀ፡ ጠቢዖት።
verses.translation: The Nathinim: the children of Suthia, the children of Asupha, the children of Tabaoth,

translations.ron: Cei încredinţaţi templului: fiii lui Ţiha, fiii lui Hasufa, fiii lui Tabaot,
translations.grk: Οἱ Ναθινὶμ, υἱοὶ Σουθία, υἱοὶ Ἀσουφὰ, υἱοὶ Ταβαὼθ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ቃዴስ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ስሔል፡ ደቂቀ፡ ፋዶን።
verses.translation: the sons of Cades, the children of Siaa, the children of Phadon,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Cheros, fiii lui Siaha, fiii lui Fadon;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Κάδης, υἱοὶ Σιαὰ, υἱοὶ Φαδὼν,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ለቡና፡ ደቂቀ፡ አጋባ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ዓቁብ።
verses.translation: the children of Labano, the children of Agaba, the sons of Acub,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Lebana, fiii lui Hagaba, fiii lui Acub;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Λαβανὼ, υἱοὶ Ἀγαβὰ, υἱοὶ Ἀκοὺβ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አጋብ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ስላሚ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሐናን።
verses.translation: the children of Agab, the children of Selami, the children of Anan,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Hagab, fiii lui Şamlai, fiii lui Hanan;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Ἀγὰβ, υἱοὶ Σελαμὶ, υἱοὶ Ἀνὰν,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ጋዱል፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጋሐር፡ ደቂቀ፡ ራድ።
verses.translation: the children of Geddel, the children of Gaar, the children of Raia,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ghidel, fiii lui Gahar, fiii lui Reaia;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Γεδδὴλ, υἱοὶ Γαὰρ, υἱοὶ Ῥαϊὰ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ራሶን፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኒቆዳ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጋሴም።
verses.translation: the children of Rason, the children of Necoda, the children of Gazem,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Reţin, fiii lui Necoda;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Ῥασὼν, υἱοὶ Νεκωδὰ, υἱοὶ Γαζὲμ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አዝያት፡ ደቂቀ፡ ፋሂስ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ባሲ።
verses.translation: the children of Azo, the children of Phase, the children of Basi,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Gazam, fiii lui Uza, fiii lui Paseah;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Ἀζὼ, υἱοὶ Φασὴ, υἱοὶ Βασὶ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አሲና፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሚናሚን፡ ደቂቀ፡ ናፌሶን።
verses.translation: the children of Asena, the children of Moünim, the children of Nephusim,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Besai, fiii lui Asna, fiii lui Meunim;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Ἀσενὰ, υἱοὶ Μοουνὶμ, υἱοὶ Νεφουσὶμ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ብቊበቊ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አቁፋ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሐሩር።
verses.translation: the children of Bacbuc, the children of Acupha, the children of Arur,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Nefişim, fiii lui Bacbuc;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Βακβοὺκ, υἱοὶ Ἀκουφὰ, υἱοὶ Ἀροὺρ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ባስሎት፡ ደቂቀ፡ ማሁድ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኦሪስ።
verses.translation: the children of Basaloth, the children of Mauda, the children of Arsa,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Hacufa, fiii lui Harhur, fiii lui Baţlut, fiii lui Mechida, fiii lui Harşa;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Βασαλὼθ, υἱοὶ Μαουδὰ, υἱοὶ Ἀρσὰ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ብርቊስ፡ ደቂቀ፡ የሲሰራ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ቴማ።
verses.translation: the children of Barcos, the children of Sisara, the children of Thema,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Barcos, fiii lui Sisera, fiii lui Tamah;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Βαρκὸς, υἱοὶ Σισάρα, υἱοὶ Θεμὰ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ንስያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አጡፋ።
verses.translation: the children of Nasthie, the children of Atupha.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Neţiah, fiii lui Hatifa.
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Νασθιὲ, υἱοὶ Ἀτουφά·

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ አግብርቲሁ፡ ለሰሎሞን፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሳጢ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አስፌርታ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ፋዱርሐ።
verses.translation: The children of the servants of Solomon: the children of Sotai, the children of Sephera, the children of Phadura,

translations.ron: Fiii robilor lui Solomon: fiii lui Sotai, fiii lui Soferet, fiii lui Peruda;
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ δούλων Σαλωμὼν, υἱοὶ Σωταῒ, υἱοὶ Σεφηρὰ, υἱοὶ Φαδουρὰ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ኢያሄል፡ ደቂቀ፡ ደርቆን፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጌዴል።
verses.translation: the children of Jeela, the children of Darcon, the children of Gedel,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iaala, fiii lui Darcon, fiii lui Ghidel;
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Ἰεηλὰ, υἱοὶ Δαρκὼν, υἱοὶ Γεδὴλ,

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ሴፋትያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አጤል፡ ደቂቀ፡ ፎኬርት፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሐጺባይም፡ ደቂቀ፡ አሚ።
verses.translation: the children of Saphatia, the children of Atil, the children of Phacherath, the children of Aseboim, the children of Emei.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şefatia, fiii lui Hatil, fiii lui Pocheret-Haţebaim, fiii lui Ami.
translations.grk: υἱοὶ Σαφατία, υἱοὶ Ἀτὶλ, υἱοὶ Φαχερὰθ, υἱοὶ Ἀσεβωεὶμ, υἱοὶ Ἡμεΐ.

verses.geez: ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ናታናውያን፡ ወደቂቀ፡ አብደሴልማ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወተስዓ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: All the Nathanim, and the sons of Abdeselma were three hundred and ninety-two.

translations.ron: Cei încredinţaţi templului şi fiii robilor lui Solomon erau cu toţii trei sute nouăzeci şi doi;
translations.grk: Πάντες οἱ Ναθανὶμ, καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀβδησελμὰ, τριακόσιοι ἐννενηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ወእሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ ዓርጉ፡ እምተልመላ፡ ተላርሳ፡ ወኪሩብ፡ ወሔዳያን፡ ወኔሜር፡ ወአበዩ፡ አይድዖ፡ ቤተ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ ወዘመዶሙ፡ እንዘ፡ እምእስራኤል፡ እሙንቱ።
verses.translation: And these are they that went up from Thelmelech, Thelaresa, Cherub, Hedan, Emmer: and they were not able to tell the house of their fathers, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

translations.ron: Iar cei ce au ieşit din Telmelah, din Telharşa şi din Cherub-Adan-Imer, care n-au putut să-şi arate seminţia şi neamul lor, ca să arate că sunt din Israel, au fost:
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἀναβάντες ἀπὸ Θελμελὲχ, Θελαρησὰ, Χεροὺβ, Ἡδὰν, Ἐμμὴρ· καὶ οὐκ ἐδυνάσθησαν τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι οἶκον πατριᾶς αὐτῶν καὶ σπέρμα αὐτῶν, εἰ ἐξ Ἰσραήλ εἰσιν·

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ ዳላያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጦብያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኒቆዳ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሐምሳ፡ ወክልኤቱ።
verses.translation: the children of Dalæa, the children of Bua, the children of Tobias, the children of Necoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Delaia, fiii lui Tobie şi fiii lui Necoda: şase sute cincizeci şi doi.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Δαλαΐα, υἱοὶ Βουὰ, υἱοὶ Τωβίου, υἱοὶ Νεκωδὰ, ἑξακόσιοι πεντηκονταδύο.

verses.geez: ወእምነ፡ ትውልደ፡ ካህናት፡ ደቂቀ፡ ላብያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አቆስ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ቤርዜሊ፡ ዘአውሰበ፡ ብእሲተ፡ እምአዋልደ፡ ቤርዜሊ፡ ገለአዳዊ፡ ወተሰምየ፡ በስሞሙ።
verses.translation: And of the children of the priests, the children of Labeia, the children of Akkus, the children of Berzellai, who took a wife of the daughter of Berzellai the Galaadite, and was called by their name.

translations.ron: Iar din neamul preoţilor: fiii lui Hobaia, fiii lui Hacoţ şi fiii lui Barzilai care şi-a luat femeie din fiicele lui Barzilai Galaaditul al cărui nume l-a adoptat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων υἱοὶ Λαβεία, υἱοὶ Ἀκκοὺς, υἱοὶ Βερζελλαῒ, ὃς ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων Βερζελλαῒ τοῦ Γαλααδίτου γυναῖκα, καὶ ἐκλήθη ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወፈቀዱ፡ ይጽሐፍዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሜቶሔሴም፡ ወኢረከብዎሙ፡ ወሠዐርዎሙ፡ እምክህነቶሙ።
verses.translation: These sought their genealogy as though they had been reckoned, but they were not found; and they were removed, as polluted, from the priesthood.

translations.ron: Şi-au căutat cartea spiţei neamului lor şi n-au găsit-o şi de aceea au fost îndepărtaţi de la preoţie.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι ἐζήτησαν γραφὴν αὐτῶν οἱ μεθωεσὶμ, καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθησαν, καὶ ἠγχιστεύθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἱερατείας.

verses.geez: ወኣሙ፡ ሐቴርስታ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ እምነ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይሠየም፡ ሊቀ፡ ካህናት፡ ዘይለብስ፡ ዲሎሶነ፡ ዘይሠረርዖሙ፡ ለፍጹማን።
verses.translation: And the Athersastha told them that they should not eat of the most holy things, until a priest should arise with Lights and Perfections.

translations.ron: Şi Tirşata le-a zis să nu mănânce din cele sfinte, până nu se va ridica preot cu Urim şi Tumim.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ἀθερσασθὰ αὐτοῖς τοῦ μὴ φαγεῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων, ἕως ἀναστῇ ἱερεὺς τοῖς φωτίζουσι καὶ τοῖς τελείοις.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ማኅበሮሙ፡ አርባዕተ፡ እልፍ፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ምእት፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወስሳ፡ እንበለ፡ አግብርቲሆሙ፡ ወአእማቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: And all the congregation together were about forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty;

translations.ron: Deci toată adunarea la un loc se alcătuia din patruzeci şi două de mii trei sute şaizeci de oameni,
translations.grk: Πᾶσα δὲ ἡ ἐκκλησία ὁμοῦ ὡσεὶ τέσσαρες μυριάδες δισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα,

verses.geez: ወእሙንቱኒ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ምእት፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ወስድስቱ።
verses.translation: besides their men-servants and maid-servants, and these were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven: and among these were two hundred singing men and singing women.

translations.ron: Afară de robii lor şi de roabele lor, care erau în număr de şapte mii trei sute treizeci şi şapte; şi mai erau cu ei două sute de cântăreţi şi cântăreţe;
translations.grk: χωρὶς δούλων αὐτῶν καὶ παιδισκῶν αὐτῶν, οὗτοι ἑπτακισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι τριακονταεπτά· καὶ οὗτοι ᾄδοντες καὶ ᾄδουσαι διακόσιοι.

verses.geez: ወመዘምራን፡ ወመዘምራትሂ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ምእት።
verses.translation: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six, their mules, two hundred and forty-five.

translations.ron: Şi aveau şapte sute treizeci şi şase de cai,
translations.grk: Ἵπποι αὐτῶν, ἑπτακόσιοι τριακονταέξ· ἡμίονοι αὐτῶν, διακόσιοι τεσσαρακονταπέντε·

verses.geez: ወአፍራሲሆሙ፡ ሰብዓቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ወስድስቱ፡ ወአብቅሊሆሙ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወአርባዓ፡ ወሐምስቱ።
verses.translation: Their camels, four hundred and thirty-five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

translations.ron: Două sute patruzeci şi cinci de catâri, patru sute treizeci şi cinci de cămile şi şase mii şapte sute douăzeci de asini.
translations.grk: Κάμηλοι αὐτῶν, τετρακόσιοι τριακονταπέντε· ὄνοι αὐτῶν, ἑξακισχίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι εἴκοσι.

verses.geez: ወአግማሊሆሙ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ወሐምስቱ፡ ወአእዱጊሆሙ፡ ስሳ፡ ምእት፡ ወሰብዐቱ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ።
verses.translation: And some of the chiefs of families, when they went into the house of the Lord that was in Jerusalem, offered willingly for the house of God, to establish it on its prepared place.

translations.ron: Şi ajungând unele din căpeteniile seminţiilor la templul Domnului care este la Ierusalim, au dăruit de bunăvoie pentru templul lui Dumnezeu, ca să fie ridicat din nou pe temeliile lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ ἀρχόντων πατριῶν ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου τὸν ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, ἡκουσιάσαντο εἰς οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ, τοῦ στῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: ወእምነ፡ መላእክተ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ ሶበ፡ በጽሑ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኢየሩሳሌም፡ በዕዑ፡ ለቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በዘይገብርዎ።
verses.translation: According to their power they gave into the treasury of the work pure gold sixty-one thousand pieces, and five thousand pounds of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

translations.ron: Şi aceştia din prisosul lor au dăruit în casa obştească pentru începerea lucrărilor: şaizeci şi una de mii de drahme de aur, cinci mii de mine de argint şi o sută de veşminte preoţeşti.
translations.grk: ὡς ἡ δύναμις αὐτῶν, ἔδωκαν εἰς θησαυρὸν τοῦ ἔργου χρυσίον καθαρὸν μναὶ ἓξ μυριάδες καὶ χίλιαι, καὶ ἀργυρίου μνὰς πεντακισχιλίας, καὶ κόθωνοι τῶν ἱερέων ἑκατόν.

verses.geez: ወበአምጣነ፡ ይክሉ፡ አብኡ፡ ለመዝገብ፡ ለፃእፃኣ፡ ግብር፡ ወርቀ፡ ንጡፈ፡ ምናነ፡ ስድስ፡ እልፈ፡ ወዓሠርተ፡ ምእተ፡ ወብሩረ፡ ምናነ፡ ሐምሳ፡ ምእተ፡ ወአልባሰ፡ ካህናት፡ ምእተ።
verses.translation: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nathinim, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

translations.ron: Şi au început să locuiască preoţii şi leviţii şi poporul şi cântăreţii şi portarii şi cei încredinţaţi templului în oraşele lor şi tot Israelul s-a aşezat în cetăţile sale.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάθισαν οἱ ἱερεῖς, καὶ οἱ Λευῖται, καὶ οἱ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες, καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ, καὶ οἱ Ναθινὶμ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν, καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወነበሩ፡ ካህናት፡ ወሌዋውያን፡ ወሕዝብኒ፡ ወመዘምራንኒ፡ ወዓፀውት፡ ወናታናውያን፡ በበአህጉሪሆሙ፡ ወእስራኤልኒ፡ ውስተ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ።
